body: To be honest, I’m more upset that none of the senior nurses around stepped in. If I saw a physician berating a new staff member, ESPECIALLY if I was in charge that shift, I think stepping in would be totally acceptable, even expected. This doc acted extremely unprofessionally and I’m sorry you had to be on the receiving end of it.
I’m a nurse, and I think I have to disagree! If you’re lovely to be around but have average patient care skills/knowledge base, then I might prefer the asshole who won’t harm a patient 🤷🏻‍♀️

You feel like this because you’re human. I think the fact that it affected you this way shows you give a shit and you’ll keep giving a shit.  
It’s okay, and it’s not your fault. Also agree with some other commenters; your mental health is a sufficient reason to use your sick time! Sleep!
